Title: Material 3 Pass — Dashboard & Task Creation

Summary
- Polish the primary flows with Material 3 components, clear difficulty affordances, and fast add/edit. Keep surfaces minimal but delightful.

Scope
- Dashboard: large Add Task, category chips, clear difficulty picker; stable keys to reduce rebuilds.
- Task Creation: defaults prefilled; distinct difficulty labels + color roles; live XP preview.
- Accessibility: dynamic text, 44px targets, contrast tokens.

Acceptance Criteria
- No overflow at large text sizes; tap targets ≥44px.
- Contrast meets WCAG AA for primary tokens.
- Performance remains smooth on large lists.

Links
- Roadmap: Fun‑First MVP (Pre‑Beta).
- UI/UX: agents.md guidelines.
